title: William Gunston's 'Tower of London' remark on charged wing edges

tellings.quote: because I don't want to end up in the Tower of London.

plain: A writer named William Gunston, in a history of aero-engine technology for Air International magazine, is said to have touched on electrically charged wing edges on aircraft and then stopped short, saying he would go no further "because I don't want to end up in the Tower of London." Michels quotes the line himself, as something he has read, as a hint that the subject was secret enough that a writer felt he could not say more. Neither he nor the line gives a date.
